item.title: SHAFT 0.79.0
item.description:
Added

  • Mac: choose the recording microphone for meetings (Meeting → Microphone): System Default or any connected input, kept across launches. A chosen microphone that is not connected at start falls back to the default and says so.
  • Mac: a Meetings button in the chat header, beside Cycles, opens the Meetings window (as Show Meetings, ⌥⌘M). Every header button has a tooltip.

Fixed

  • Mac: the menu bar showed Meeting twice; there is one Meeting menu.
  • bin/shaft runs the app-installed Python 3.12 instead of the first python3 on PATH (Apple's 3.9 crashed the supervisor from a Terminal), and says which interpreter it found when none fits.
  • Google setup: the Chat app step says to turn off interactive features, so Save needs no HTTP endpoint URL.
